method: PDD-style FCD proxy adapted to Sentinel-2 L2A
reference_year_assumption: 2566/2023 is a satellite reference requested by the user; it is not the PDD's official T-VER baseline survey date

calibration.pdd_adaptation: AVI + BSI -> PCA -> fixed VD; CSI -> fixed SSI; FCD=sqrt(VD*SSI+1)-1
calibration.temporal_rule: PCA/scaling fitted once on March-2023 and frozen for later March observations
calibration.warning: Screening adaptation; not a verified remote-sensing carbon model and not identical to the PDD Landsat-8 implementation.
